mechanism_narrative: A low federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) compresses discount rates for equity valuation, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days when the rate is below 4.0%.
evidence_refs: fact:2008-2010 Fed Funds rate < 4.0% coincided with 150% SPX gain
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns when FEDFUNDS < 4.0% are not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05).
